subject: UNSTRING statement
notes: kb/Work PB980 (2026-09-22). Unenforced before: `UNSTRING S DELIMITED BY "," INTO NR` with S PIC X(4) and NR PIC N(3) compiled clean and ran (NR=[AB ]). Now identifier-1, every delimiter, every identifier-4 and identifier-5 are asked of the ONE all-or-nothing predicate STRING SR1 and INSPECT SR4 share (AllOrNothingClass, COBOL2306); identifier-6 is not named. A figurative delimiter takes identifier-1's class (GR7) and never mixes. DETERMINATION D-UN3 (docs/CONFORMANCE.md): a numeric identifier-4 answers by its usage, as SR4 pairs them - read by category alone SR3 would leave SR4's usage-national numeric arm unusable. Category national is a 2002 introduction; at 85 the operands cannot be declared.
